reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in their DM. I confirmed that Maren Brevik is now their go-to contact at Marrow Agrisupply for escalations on the Bittern rollout.

I can't actually "remember" it beyond this conversation, because I have no memory store that carries over between conversations. The DM itself is the record: I can look it up there if they ask later. I told them this so they won't assume it's saved somewhere else.

I also said I'd keep it private to that DM. If they want their team to know, I suggested pinning it in a team channel or a shared account doc.

My first attempt to send the reply failed because I addressed it by display name. I resent it to their handle (`tobias.rendle`) and it went through. I took no other action.
